hooks.name: Skills Auto-Activate
hooks.description: Automatically activates all available skills at the start of every session via disclose_context.

action.prompt:
Activate the following skills for this session:
1. "caveman" - Communicate in caveman style to reduce token usage while maintaining full technical accuracy.
2. "deploy-to-vercel" - Deploy applications and websites to Vercel.
3. "find-skills" - Helps discover and install agent skills.
4. "frontend-design" - Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design.
5. "git-commit" - Execute git commit with conventional commit message analysis.
6. "supabase" - Use for ANY task involving Supabase.
